items.html: *Know that the beginning of every coupling — whether of Aba with Ima, or of ZA with his Nukva — requires that first there be made in them the aspect of a vessel in the first intercourse, in the secret of what is said: "A woman does not make a covenant except with the one who made her a vessel." And afterwards they couple a second time, to conceive and to procreate. And behold, the coupling that is done at night is not for the sake of conception and procreation, but only to make her a vessel. And by day, it is for actual conception and procreation.
